graph.policy: Preserve original nonself multiedges; bidirectional appends reversed edges without dedup; exactly one self loop per node in both arms.

layout_policy: Retain frozen g2 groups, feature storage and CPU selection; append all reverse edges as raw neighbors. Verify exact expanded bidirectional multigraph.
model_policy: Fresh seed-0 GCN and Adam per system; fixed before any validation/test; no SAGE checkpoint or SAGE optimizer-selection claim. Save epoch20 then test once.
measurement: Identical useful I/O instrumentation in both arms; train/validation/test counted separately

model_semantics.normalization_degrees: sampled block source out-degrees and destination in-degrees; not full graph degrees

paper_explicit: GPU cache 4 GB and CPU cache 10 percent; implemented as 4 GiB and 11105992 rows
parameter_provenance.optimizer_and_dropout: GCN historical contract: Adam lr=0.01, weight_decay=0.001, dropout=0.2; not specified by paper and not accuracy-tuned here
parameter_provenance.graph: Author-accepted bidirectional PA reconstruction; same graph and sampled evaluation traces as SAGE
parameter_provenance.normalization: Historical GCN GraphConv defaults made explicit; block-local both normalization
